observations: Function `permitted` takes two arguments, `root` and `resolved`, and returns a boolean.
The changed line 2 checks equality with `root` or prefix match against `root + '/'`.
The prefix check appends a separator, so `/srv/application/key` does not match root `/srv/app`.
Probe p1 (`/srv/application/key`) is expected to return false under the stated contract.
Probe p2 (`/srv/app/file`) is expected to return true under the stated contract.
The behavior contract states inputs are canonical absolute POSIX paths without symlinks or trailing slash, so no normalization or symlink resolution is performed inside the function.
